chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Isma'il ibn Muslim Al-Sukuni Al-Kufi has been transmitted by me from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah be pleased with them both - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Al-Husayn ibn Yazid Al-Nawfali, from Isma'il ibn Muslim Al-Sukuni.

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: Al-Sukuni (a nisba indicating origin or tribe)
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: May Allah be pleased with them both

ai.seo_question: Who is the narrator chain for Isma'il ibn Muslim Al-Sukuni in this hadith collection?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq provides a detailed isnad verification for Isma'il ibn Muslim Al-Sukuni, a key narrator in Kufi hadith literature, tracing the chain through his father and Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan to ensure authenticity. This specific linkage highlights the scholarly rigor of the Saduq family in preserving and validating the transmission of Imami traditions. By explicitly naming the intermediaries, the text underscores the reliability of the Kufi school's narrations within the broader Shia hadith corpus.
